briefdescription.para: Instantiates every ClinicController member (public overrides and constrained Impl helpers) for one type.

detaileddescription.para: Definitions live in this translation unit, so explicit instantiations are required for callers that include only the header. The supported clinic entity types are listed below.

briefdescription.para: Definitions and explicit instantiations for ClinicController<T> over clinic-service entity types.

detaileddescription.para: Constrained *Impl helpers select behaviour per type: client-supplied ids for most entities, generic creation for Patient/Visits, and "not implemented" responses for unsupported Delete/Search/GetVisits.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is where the type-specific clinic rules are implemented. The non-Patient create path carefully parses a client-supplied id (with its own checks so bad input becomes a 400, not a 500), while Patient/Visits reuse the generic flow. Unsupported actions get an explicit client error instead of a bogus database call. The public methods at the bottom simply forward to the right helper, and the instantiations make all clinic types linkable.
